rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely: reuses cookieFilterAction, same module ID style, Validate, Caddyfile block shape, interface assertions added in all three var blocks.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles missing '=', empty name, quoted values, empty suffix, non-array field, first-match-wins; does not trim whitespace around name/value nor validate cookie-name tokens, so oddly formatted lines are treated as parseable.
rationale.scope: Exactly the requested filter plus registration and compile-time assertions; no unrelated edits.
rationale.readability: Clear helpers with doc comments; formatSetCookie takes four loose params rather than the setCookieParts struct it was built for.
rationale.robustness: All slicing is bounds-checked, no panics on malformed input, unknown field types pass through unchanged.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is copied verbatim from CookieFilter instead of shared; otherwise small, self-contained helpers are easy to extend.
